title: Sixteen Hundred Fifty-Four Improved Minimum-Distance Bounds and Eighteen Exact-Optimal Closures for Quantum Stabilizer Codes over GF(q) (q in {2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8})
description: Release v1.2.1 updates the compiled 18-page manuscript PDF and LaTeX source with typographical and typesetting refinements (all 397 JSON certificates, SHA-256 digests, and clean-room verifiers are unchanged from v1.2.0). Explicit pure q-ary quantum error-correcting stabilizer codes (397 parent certificates across q in {2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8}, block lengths 11 <= n <= 100, and pure minimum distances 4 <= d <= 16) constructed via (1) comb-free multi-eigenmode Vandermonde bordered constacyclic Hermitian codes with spectral discrete Fourier diagonalization, (2) equivariant GF(q)-linear symplectic stabilizer codes for odd and even stabilizer ranks r_S = n - k, (3) symmetry-free navigation of the Hermitian isotropic Grassmannian via Dieudonne-Witt rank-1 unitary Householder reflections, and (4) Frobenius-conjugated 2-block and 3-block non-singular-by-columns (NSC) quasi-unitary matrix-product codes over projective generalized Reed-Solomon components. Strictly improves 1,450 minimum-distance lower bounds in Markus Grassl's CodeTables.de as pure stabilizer codes (closing 16 entries to exact optimality) under strictly pure secondary propagation (PureSubcode, Puncture, Shorten), 1,575 entries under single-operator propagation, and 1,654 entries (closing 18 previously open entries to d_low = d_up, including non-GRS Quantum MDS codes [[11, 1, 6]]_5 and self-dual [[12, 0, 7]]_5) when appending terminal weight-1 stabilizer extension (Extend). Includes full manuscript (PDF/LaTeX), all 397 JSON certificates with SHA-256 digests, machine-readable impact report, four zero-shared-code multi-threaded Rust clean-room verifiers, Python audit suite, and native Magma verification scripts.
